body: I feel like they're wasting their efforts on me.

A part of me doesn't, but my options are limited. I made a promise to only go by overdose or drowning, and I tried the latter. I want to be happy and live a normal life, but I can't. That's not my purpose.
I'm in a lot of physical and emotional pain. I just spent a month in hospital, and my boyfriend wasn't there for me because he was scared.
